_comment: Per-strategy disciplined-gate baseline. Each strategy's CI lower bound from the offline disciplined gate (promotion_panel 5 layers: 20y bootstrap + per-strategy slippage + block bootstrap + period stability + multi-testing). Live monitoring compares the strategy's ROLLING live PF against this baseline. Source: project_2026_05_22_backtest_factory_findings.md + 2026-05-23 rigor sprint (ops/audit/run_slippage_recalibration.py).
_slippage_methodology: slippage_bps_used is the bps figure that produced the published_ci_95_lower_at_used. _slippage_bps_realistic is the Agent 2 calibration. recalibrated_ci_95_lower_at_realistic is the bootstrap CI lower bound when the panel is rerun at the realistic level. Sourced from ops/reports/system_audit/slippage_recalibration_*.json.
generated_from: promotion_panel applied to 20y backtests + archived live trades

forge_xs_momentum.notes: Strongest config tested. Passes 8/8 layers including block bootstrap. Edge concentrates in moderate-high VIX (>=20) regimes per 5/23 audit. Monthly cadence on broad ETFs (SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA/EFA/EEM/GLD/TLT) — 10bps slippage realistic at retail size.

forge_spy_trend_follower.notes: Passes 7/8 layers. H1 fails on n=5 sub-sample (sparsity, not regime). Role: defensive beta proxy not alpha. 0.614 correlation with xs_momentum. SPY is the tightest US ETF; 5bps is more realistic than the 10bps used — actual CI lower bound likely slightly higher than 2.67.

forge_gld_pm_long.notes: Fails at 5bp slippage (the realistic figure for GLD intraday). 522 trades / 2y cadence → slippage drag destroys edge. Live evidence still useful for re-evaluation as n accumulates.

forge_nq_overnight.notes: Net loser even at 3bp slippage. 2026-05-23 recalibration at realistic 7bps: IID CI lower drops from 0.73 → 0.526. Edge does NOT exist at honest execution costs; this is a money-loser with 95% confidence. RECOMMEND: allocation_factor → 0.0. Don't continue to deploy capital here for 'evidence collection' — the disciplined gate has already answered.

forge_pead.notes: 2026-05-23 recalibration: at realistic 40bps slippage (PEAD entries hit earnings-week wide spreads + gap-fill chasing), curated-universe IID CI lower drops to 1.025 — essentially breakeven, 17.5% below the 1.20 promotion floor. Non-curated SPX-30 universe was already CI lower 1.06 at 10bps; at 40bps it would be ~0.96 = net loser. Apollo's universe selection induces survivorship bias on top. RECOMMEND: allocation_factor → 0.0. Edge in spec, but no edge in execution-adjusted reality.
